description: This Java class defines a REST API endpoint for managing 'Client' resources, including methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting client data in a Spring Boot application.

classes.name: ClientRestEndpoint
classes.description: A REST controller providing endpoints for client management operations.

methods.name: getClientInfo
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET request to retrieve information about a client by ID.

methods.name: createClientInfo
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST request to create a new client using provided resource data.

methods.name: updateClientInfo
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST request to update existing client information.

methods.name: deleteClientInfo
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE request to remove a client by ID.
